scope.coarse: The bound is for the normalized two-block projector parent of an arbitrary nonzero positive core tensor at every vertex, with the certified primitive wire channels and full-Schmidt-rank bonds.
scope.microscopic: For the actual microscopic parent, additionally prove equality of each two-block kernel with the tensor image and a finite seed gap g_seed. If each microscopic term occurs in at most Delta patches, gap >= g_seed * coarse_gap / Delta. Decorated AKLT has the required kernel identity by singlet-bracket divisibility.
scope.boundary: Use full core-plus-half-wire blocks, including dangling half-wires at the boundary. No undecorated AKLT or pressure/LDP conclusion is asserted.
